summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K solely to declare a routine monthly dividend of $0.225 per share on its common shares, payable on or about September 28, 2026 to shareholders of record as of August 31, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or shares under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is an ordinary ongoing dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a capital return event, tender offer, or strategic initiative. No structural changes, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction terms are involved. The filing is routine corporate housekeeping for a business development company and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
